scope: Nonredox K scaffold in a jointly supported JKLN redox module; not a family-specific assignment from PF00329 alone.

primary_experiment.finding: Engineered and purified P.furiosus JKLN cytoplasmic subcomplex retains reduced-Fd-driven H2 evolution. J has one FeS cluster and N two; K is part of the large-subunit architecture, not a FeS carrier.

inference: In a complete locally ordered J-K-L-N candidate, full official PF00329 GA evidence can support the K structural scaffold even when one reference pairwise alignment does not span it. NiFe catalysis and FeS relay evidence are required independently. J/EchC lineage competition can remain unresolved because their reviewed proximal relay roles are compatible at this claim level. L lineage competition remains displayed; independently supported canonical NiFe identity supplies only the coarse catalytic premise. N must retain its full homologous relay and no qualified alternate-role rival.
development_scope: A reviewed, falsifiable uncalibrated function-transfer inference. No query AA added to the sequence bank.
